The 210 CC Adventure is the compact end of TideWater's CC Adventure line: a 20 foot 10 inch center console rated for eight people and up to 200 horsepower. A 17 degree hull, 26 gallon insulated livewell, fiberglass T-top with glass enclosure and fold-down rear seat cover fishing and family days alike.

The 220 CC Adventure steps up from the 210 with a wider 8 foot 10 inch beam, an 18 degree hull and capacity for ten. Fuel rises to 71 gallons and the rating to 250 horsepower. Standard kit runs to a fiberglass T-top with glass enclosure, trim tabs, a 26 gallon insulated livewell and a fold-down rear seat.

The 232 CC Adventure carries a 20 degree hull, 95 gallons of fuel and a 300 horsepower rating, with room for ten. SeaKeeper Ride stabilization, a recessed windlass with 200 feet of rode and a 30 gallon insulated livewell are standard, and the fold-down rear seat opens the cockpit up for fishing.

The 232 LXF shares the 23 foot 8 inch hull, 20 degree deadrise and 300 horsepower rating of the 232 CC Adventure, but sits in TideWater's LXF line, pitched as luxury and versatility for the whole family. A fixed stern bench seat and insulated stern cooler replace the center console's fold-down rear seat.

The 256 CC Adventure moves into twin outboard territory: a 21 degree hull, 141 gallons of fuel, a 400 horsepower rating and capacity for twelve. Inside the console sits a china head with pump-out and a fresh water shower. A dive door, 30 gallon insulated livewell and fold-down rear seat handle the fishing.

The 256 LXF is the family-leaning trim of TideWater's 25 foot 8 inch, 21 degree hull. Against the 256 CC Adventure it swaps the fold-down rear seat for a fixed stern bench and runs a smaller 19 gallon port stern livewell, while keeping the console head, dive door and 400 horsepower twin outboard rating.

The 272 CC Adventure is yacht certified, built on a 21 degree hull with 178 gallons of fuel and a 500 horsepower rating. Yamaha digital steering, SeaKeeper Ride, a 28 gallon insulated livewell and a console head with fresh water shower are standard. The fold-down rear seat and dive door keep the cockpit working.

The 272 LXF takes the same yacht certified 27 foot 2 inch hull as the 272 CC Adventure and trims it toward comfort. A fixed stern bench seat replaces the fold-down rear seat, while the electric bow table and filler cushion turn the foredeck into a lounge. The console head and dive door stay standard.

The 282 CC Adventure runs a 22 degree hull, 205 gallons of fuel and a 600 horsepower rating. Dual dive doors, recessed rod racks, a tackle center leaning post with sink and insulated aquarium livewells make it a serious fishing platform, while fixed fiberglass bow seating and an electric bow table seat the family.

The 302 CC Adventure is yacht certified on a 22 degree hull, with 230 gallons of fuel and a 700 horsepower rating. Wrap-around bow seating, a console lounge seat with armrests and a flush mount transom seat sit alongside an aquarium livewell leaning post, recessed rod racks and a macerated coffin box.
